message.content:
Below is a **ready‑to‑use 7‑day Paris itinerary** that covers the essentials—flights, accommodation, day‑to‑day activities, dining, transport, and a rough budget.  
Feel free to tweak the dates, add extra days, or swap activities to suit your interests and travel style.

---

## 1️⃣ Flights & Arrival

| Detail | Recommendation |
|--------|----------------|
| **Departure city** | Your home city (e.g., New York, London, Tokyo) |
| **Airlines** | Air France, Delta, British Airways, KLM, or any carrier offering direct or one‑stop flights to Paris‑Charles de Gaulle (CDG) or Orly (ORY). |
| **Best time to book** | 6–8 weeks before departure; keep an eye on fare alerts (Google Flights, Skyscanner). |
| **Arrival** | Arrive at CDG/ORY early morning or late evening to avoid crowds. |

> **Tip:** If you’re flexible, flying mid‑week (Tue‑Thu) often yields cheaper fares.

---

## 2️⃣ Accommodation (Mid‑Range)

| Option | Approx. Cost per Night | Why It’s Great |
|--------|------------------------|----------------|
| **Hotel Le Six** (Le Marais) | €180–€220 | Boutique hotel, central, free Wi‑Fi, close to Notre‑Dame. |
| **Hôtel Ekta** (Champs‑Élysées) | €170–€210 | Stylish, near Arc de Triomphe, easy metro access. |
| **Hotel du Petit Moulin** (Montmartre) | €160–€200 | Charming, historic, within walking distance of Sacré‑Coeur. |

> **Budget alternative:** Airbnb studio in the 11th arrondissement (~€90/night) or a capsule hotel like **Generator Paris** (~€50/night).

---

## 3️⃣ Transport Around Paris

| Mode | Cost | Notes |
|------|------|-------|
| **Paris Visite Pass (Unlimited Metro/RER)** | €20–€30/day (depending on zones) | Covers all public transport; buy 2‑day or 3‑day passes. |
| **Navigo Week Pass** | €22.80 | Unlimited travel for the week (Mon‑Sun) – great if you’ll be in Paris for 5+ days. |
| **Taxi/Uber** | €10–€25 per ride | Use for airport transfers or late‑night trips. |
| **Bike Share (Vélib’)** | €1.90 per hour | Fun way to explore neighborhoods. |

> **Pro tip:** Buy a Navigo Week Pass at the airport or any metro station; it’s cheaper than buying single tickets each day.

---

## 4️⃣ Daily Itinerary (7 Days)

| Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening |
|-----|---------|-----------|---------|
| **Day 1 – Arrival & Settling In** | Check‑in, freshen up | Walk around your neighborhood (Le Marais or Montmartre) | Light dinner at a local bistro (e.g., **Le Petit Cler**) |
| **Day 2 – Classic Landmarks** | Louvre Museum (early opening) | Tuileries Garden & Place de la Concorde | Seine river cruise (night) |
| **Day 3 – Art & Culture** | Musée d’Orsay | Lunch at **Café Marly** | Explore Saint‑Germain‑des‑Près, jazz club (e.g., **Le Caveau de la Huchette**) |
| **Day 4 – Iconic Views** | Eiffel Tower (skip‑the‑line ticket) | Picnic at Champ‑de‑Mars | Dinner at **58 Tour Eiffel** or nearby **Le Jules Verne** |
| **Day 5 – Day Trip** | Versailles Palace & Gardens (RER C) | Explore the Hall of Mirrors, Trianon | Return to Paris, casual dinner |
| **Day 6 – Hidden Gems** | Canal Saint‑Martin walk | Visit **Musée Rodin** | Dinner in the Latin Quarter |
| **Day 7 – Shopping & Departure** | Champs‑Élysées & Arc de Triomphe | Last‑minute shopping | Airport transfer |

> **Optional extras:**  
> • **Day 8:** Disneyland Paris or a wine‑tasting tour in Champagne.  
> • **Day 9:** Explore the Marais markets, visit the Picasso Museum.

---

## 5️⃣ Dining Highlights

| Cuisine | Restaurant | Price Range (€) |
|---------|------------|-----------------|
| **Classic French** | **Le Comptoir du Relais** | 35–55 |
| **Seafood** | **Septime** (reservation required) | 45–70 |
| **Vegetarian** | **L’Arpège** (Michelin 3‑star) | 60–90 |
| **Street Food** | **Boulangerie Poilâne** | 5–15 |
| **Dessert** | **Pierre Hermé** | 10–20 |

> **Tip:** Reserve Michelin‑starred restaurants 2–3 weeks in advance; use apps like **OpenTable** or **LaFourchette**.

---

## 6️⃣ Budget Breakdown (per person)

| Category | Cost (€) | Notes |
|----------|----------|-------|
| **Flights** | 400–800 | Depends on origin & season |
| **Accommodation** | 1,200–1,500 | 7 nights at €180/night |
| **Transport** | 100–150 | Navigo Week Pass + occasional taxi |
| **Food** | 350–500 | Mix of cafés, restaurants, and street food |
| **Attractions** | 200–300 | Louvre, Musée d’Orsay, Eiffel Tower skip‑the‑line, Versailles |
| **Miscellaneous** | 100 | Souvenirs, tips, unexpected expenses |
| **Total** | **2,250–3,050** | Mid‑range traveler |

> **Savings tip:** Book a multi‑day museum pass (e.g., **Paris Museum Pass** €60) to save on entry fees.

---

## 7️⃣ Packing Checklist

| Item | Why |
|------|-----|
| Comfortable walking shoes | Paris is best explored on foot. |
| Light rain jacket | Weather can be unpredictable. |
| Power adapter (Type C/F) | For charging electronics. |
| Reusable water bottle | Stay hydrated while sightseeing. |
| Small daypack | Carry essentials during day trips. |
| Travel insurance | Covers health, cancellations, and lost luggage. |

---

## 8️⃣ Quick Reference

| Resource | Link |
|----------|------|
| **Flight search** | https://www.google.com/flights |
| **Paris Pass** | https://www.parispass.com |
| **Navigo Pass** | https://www.ratp.fr/en/navigo |
| **Hotel booking** | https://www.booking.com |
| **Restaurant reservations** | https://www.lafourchette.com |

---

### Final Thoughts

- **Flexibility**: Keep a few “free” days in your schedule to wander, discover cafés, or revisit favorite spots.  
- **Language**: A few basic French phrases (“Bonjour”, “Merci”, “Où est…?”) go a long way.  
- **Safety**: Keep an eye on your belongings in crowded areas; use a money belt or hidden pouch.

Enjoy your Paris adventure! If you’d like a customized version (different dates, budget, or interests), let me know and I’ll tailor it further. Bon voyage!
